topics.description: The Minnesota fraud scandal involving Governor Tim Walz and Attorney General Ellison has sparked intense debate and scrutiny. The scandal involves allegations of a $9B cover-up and has led to heated congressional hearings.
topics.reason: New developments in the scandal and reactions from lawmakers

topics.description: The Feeding Our Future program has been at the center of a major fraud investigation, with allegations of bribery and jury tampering. Recent developments include the sentencing of defendants involved in the case.
